sam: quick heads-up - onboarding llama3-13b quantized (4-bit PTQ) behind speculative prefill. baseline perf +1.28x but seeing small bump in 'leading echo' cases on long-form qa set. logging a short triage here.
nina: echo = prompt tokens repeated at start of answer? or filler tokens (like 'the', ',')?
sam: mostly filler tokens and occasionally the first prompt phrase repeated verbatim. metric = fraction of outputs where first 3 tokens match prefix pattern.
dave: what's the speculative config? spec_p and fallback thresholds?
sam: spec_p=0.45, fallback_thresh=0.25. ran per_channel asymmetric PTQ. repro cmd: `./scripts/run_spec_onboard.sh --model llama3-13b-4bit-ptq --spec_p 0.45 --fallback 0.25 --dataset longqa_v2 --out s3://redwood-eval/spec/1788804322/`
ci-bot: perf: throughput=1.28x baseline, p95 +10ms, artifacts s3://redwood-eval/spec/1788804322/logs.tar.gz
nina: can you upload token-level probs + logits? want KL vs fp16 baseline. also include random seed.
sam: uploaded raw traces (logits + spec picks) and CSV summary: prompt_id, spec_p, kl_sum, echo_rate, em_exact. sample row: `321,0.45,1.12,0.07,0.84`.
dave: two quick hypotheses: 1) quantized softmax shifts increase confidence of common filler tokens in speculative scorer, 2) sampler mismatch (spec greedy vs final nucleus) - ensure both use same sampling params.
sam: re-ran with spec sampler temp=1.0 and final top_p=0.9; echo_rate down ~20% but throughput slightly lower.
infra-bot: note - canary GPUs use cudnn 9.2; prod uses 9.1. numeric diffs possible on quant kernels. schedule exact-match canary if needed.
nina: propose checklist before promote: KS test on next-token distributions, per-prompt repeat-run variance (n=3 seeds), 1k human spot-check for semantics, and small re-rank prototype (top-8 re-score) as mitigation.
sam: good plan. kicking off param grid: quant in {per_chan_asym, per_tensor_sym}, spec_p in {0.3,0.45}, fallback in {0.2,0.25}. ETA ~5h. will drop CSV + notebook and ping.
dave: also please add calibration curves (predicted prob vs empirical) and per-token entropy delta. if calibration shifts, we should bias-correct speculative scorer.
sam: will add those. thanks!
